_: Hudební styly pro podkres pohádek. Každý styl má 5 skladeb (Lyria 3 Pro, ~2–3 min), přehrávač je hraje za sebou s prolnutím. Prompt = základ + varianta + SPOLECNE.
SPOLECNE: Instrumental background music for a children's audio story that is read aloud over it, no drums, no vocals, quiet and even dynamics throughout without big crescendos, about 3 minutes long, ends softly.
